# QuimeraTech

## Description

QuimeraTech is a software house based in Portugal. It develops digital solutions for companies seeking custom software, technology consulting, Cloud architecture, custom CRM, and digital transformation.

## How we work

The team combines business discovery, architecture, development, and continuous improvement to create digital products aligned with each organization's goals.

## Frequently asked questions

### What services does QuimeraTech provide?

Custom software development, Cloud Architecture consulting, custom CRM development, and digital transformation.

### Where does QuimeraTech operate?

QuimeraTech operates from Portugal and works with clients globally.

### How can I start a conversation?

Email general@quimeratech.com or use the contact form available at https://quimeratech.com/.
